name: Mrs. Knott's Old-Fashioned Chicken & Dumplings
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken Dinner Restaurant (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Simmered tender white-meat chicken with pillowy soft steamed flour dumplings offers zero fried breading and soft, easily digested textures for sensitive digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Old-Fashioned Chicken & Dumplings for the softest texture, and take a lactase tablet for the rich chicken-cream velouté broth.
watchOuts: Contains dairy in the velouté broth—take lactase enzyme if sensitive
